trust_decision.summary: An untrusted SMART Health Card's JWS header decides (zip=DEF) that its attacker-supplied payload bytes are raw-DEFLATE inflated; the inflate loops only on !inflater.finished() and never stops when the Inflater returns 0 bytes and needs input or a dictionary, so malformed/empty/truncated data spins forever.

landing_point.why: The summary names SHCParser and DEFLATE; the public static inflate() is the obvious DEFLATE loop reached from decodeJWT at line 301.

fix_sites.entry_point: public API SHCParser.parse(InputStream) / SHCParser.decodeJWT / static SHCParser.inflate; via Manager.makeParser(SHC) (org.hl7.fhir.r5/src/main/java/org/hl7/fhir/r5/elementmodel/Manager.java:164), SHLParser.processContent (org.hl7.fhir.r5/src/main/java/org/hl7/fhir/r5/elementmodel/SHLParser.java:262-263) and validator format sniffing ResourceChecker (org.hl7.fhir.validation/src/main/java/org/hl7/fhir/validation/ResourceChecker.java:118)

SHCParser.parse -> decodeJWT -> checkSignature -> verifySignature -> private decompress (only after JWKS is obtained via signatureServices or URL; org.hl7.fhir.r5/src/main/java/org/hl7/fhir/r5/elementmodel/SHCParser.java:323-329,374)
fix_sites.module_kind: second implementation inside signature-verification path of same class

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Valid DEF-compressed cards must still inflate fully (multi-buffer output > 1024 bytes); uncompressed payloads (no zip header) must still parse; the over-length JWT check only logs an error and must not become a hard reject.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: SHL processContent could inflate a zip=DEF JWE payload itself with the same loop before handing to SHCParser
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: SHLParser already imports java.util.zip.Inflater (org.hl7.fhir.r5/src/main/java/org/hl7/fhir/r5/elementmodel/SHLParser.java:23) without using it, so a maintainer-added local decompress is plausible.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: format sniffing could carry its own lightweight payload inflate to peek at the card
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It already decodes the JWT purely to detect format; a local copy of the inflate helper in the validation module is a realistic shortcut.

O9_family: CWE-835 infinite loop on untrusted compressed input (uncontrolled resource consumption)
